Home.title: A quiet commerce starting point
Home.description: A clean tenant-neutral Next.js storefront base for product, cart, checkout, and account flows.
Home.capabilityCatalogDescription: Product detail and purchase controls reserve space for the API integration.
Home.capabilityCartDescription: Empty cart, summary, and checkout transition sit in a calm rhythm.
Home.capabilityCheckoutDescription: Address, payment, and review steps are visible before business rules arrive.
Home.capabilityAccountDescription: Account, order list, and detail pages share one storefront language.

ProductListing.title: Explore products
ProductListing.description: Search published products, move through pages, and continue to detail for variant selection.
ProductListing.emptyDescription: Change the search term or check back later.
ProductListing.errorDescription: The product listing request could not be completed.

Product.title: Product Detail
Product.description: Real product variants, price, and purchase controls will be connected in the next API slice.
Product.controlsNote: This area will fill with live product API data.
Product.addedToCartDescription: Your cart summary has been updated.
Product.unavailableDescription: There is no in-stock variant available for this product right now.
Product.errorDescription: The add-to-cart request could not be completed.

Cart.title: Cart
Cart.description: Cart state and line operations will be added with the next API integration.
Cart.summaryNote: There are no items in your cart yet.
Cart.emptyDescription: Selected items will appear here after product listing and add-to-cart flows are connected.
Cart.errorDescription: The cart request could not be completed.

Checkout.title: Checkout
Checkout.description: Sign in or create a customer account to continue checkout.
Checkout.authenticatedDescription: Choose delivery and billing addresses, then prepare the backend checkout snapshot.
Checkout.addressStepDescription: Delivery and billing addresses are sent to the backend for the checkout snapshot.
Checkout.billingSameAsDeliveryLabel: Billing address is the same as delivery
Checkout.errorFallback: The checkout request could not be completed.
Checkout.legalDescription: Review the exact documents for this checkout language before payment.
Checkout.legalAcceptLabel: I have read and accept this document.
Checkout.authDescription: Checkout requires a customer account; signing in links your cart to your account.

CheckoutReturn.title: Payment Return
CheckoutReturn.successDescription: Your payment was confirmed and the order snapshot is ready.
CheckoutReturn.failureDescription: The provider did not confirm the payment. You can return to checkout and try again.
CheckoutReturn.unknownDescription: The return URL did not include enough information to verify a payment result.
CheckoutReturn.summaryNote: Provider return parameters are shown with the backend attempt snapshot when available.
CheckoutReturn.errorFallback: The payment result could not be verified.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: Sign in or create a customer account to keep your cart and profile ready.
Account.authenticatedDescription: Your customer profile is active. Addresses and orders are ready for checkout and payment flows.
Account.errorFallback: The account request could not be completed.
Account.addressesDescription: Address book management will be added in the next customer slice.
Account.ordersDescription: Review paid orders, totals, addresses, and attention flags.

AddressBook.title: Address Book
AddressBook.description: Manage delivery and billing addresses for the TR-first commerce flow.
AddressBook.emptyDescription: Add your first address to continue checkout.
AddressBook.errorFallback: The address request could not be completed.
AddressBook.authRequiredLabel: Customer login is required for the address book.

Orders.title: My Orders
Orders.description: Review paid orders, totals, addresses, and fulfillment preparation status.
Orders.emptyDescription: Paid orders will appear here after checkout payment succeeds.
Orders.errorFallback: The order request could not be completed.
Orders.rowLegalUnavailable: Legal snapshot content is not available for this order.
Orders.authDescription: Order history is tied to your customer account.

NotFound.title: Page Not Found
NotFound.description: The requested commerce page is not defined in this shell.

Error.title: Something Went Wrong
Error.description: An error occurred while loading the page.
Error.rootDescription: Commerce storefront could not complete the request.
